title: card.returned payload, schemaVersion 1
description: A card left the table, headed back into the Shuffler's game state (e.g. dragged off the playmat). The table isn't authoritative for a table card's face, so unlike card.played/card.discarded this event carries no `face` field (two-faced-cards watch point 19) — `face` is explicitly blacklisted (`"face": false`) rather than merely undeclared, since a sender copying card.played's shape by habit is the likely mistake to guard against; every other unknown property still passes through per the fleet's additionalProperties:true policy. Identity here is scryfallId plus gameCardIndex (the Shuffler's own decklist rank) rather than the instanceId GUID card.played uses — the table doesn't mint or track instanceId, and gameCardIndex is what the Shuffler can look a card back up by.

scryfallId.description: Definition: the exact printing — oracle identity, all faces, all names, all images derivable.

gameCardIndex.description: The card's index in the Shuffler's initial decklist array (its alphabetical rank in that list) — how the Shuffler looks this card back up in its own game state.

seat.description: The seatId of the player this card is returning to — a bare non-empty check, matching card.played.v1's `owner` field.

fromZone.description: Where on the table the card was returning from. A hint — geography, not rules.
